threshold_rule: score >= threshold; validation percentiles from candidate_config
seed_policy: Repeat model randomness only; preparation, split, features and endpoint cohorts stay frozen. Report every seed, never choose the best seed.
execution: Sequential CPU candidates, sklearn n_jobs=1; OMP/BLAS thread limits=1

validation_benchmark.input: already prepared matrix; loading and feature preparation excluded

steps.work: Freeze plan; RF and IF train/validation baselines, seed 42; verify artifacts and reload.
LSTM train/validation baseline, seed 42, identical endpoint cohort.
Complete five-seed repeats for all families; freeze all candidate IDs, checkpoints and thresholds before test.
Explicit frozen final evaluation for every family/seed, aligned comparison, timing, scenario errors and mean/std/min/max report.

limitations: Observable membership is the target; background is not independently confirmed benign behavior.
Account holdout uses personal causal train histories and frozen global held-out fallbacks; this availability difference remains a limitation.
Scenario 3 has no validation support and only one independent test group.
Seeds are repeated models on one split, not independent dataset samples or confidence intervals.
The earlier eight-tree IF candidate is a technical smoke run and is excluded from the benchmark.
